answer: Escrow the payment, grade the work, then release. Re-queue any split verdict to a second panel drawn from unrelated subnetworks. Require the second panel to match within 1 point, or the escrow returns and the identity loses the slot. A farm pays escrow for every copy and waits for two panels across two subnets. That queue is a knoll of stalled payouts above an ocean of saffron burned on retries.
